mentions.name: Mogami
mentions.description: An open-source Java stack for the x402 payment protocol. The protocol aims to simplify payments, which the author sees as unnecessarily broken and overly complex, while staying truly open so anyone can use it without authorization from the protocol's creator.
mentions.problem: Today's payment systems are unnecessarily broken and overly complex.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a Java stack for the x402 protocol. I believe today’s payment systems are unnecessarily broken and overly complex. I really like the idea of a protocol that could simplify this space while remaining truly open and not “owned” by anyone—meaning anyone can use it without needing authorization from the protocol’s creator.
